# Encoder speed pass — 2026-10-23

Build: `99f365b` + uncommitted diff (bits.rs, codec.rs, main.rs, rc.rs,
v1/enc.rs — +1076/−258). All changes are implementation-only: every codec
decision, and therefore every output byte, is unchanged.

Source file: `sample_pack/875489__newlocknew__wind_autumnmidnightresidential-areawind-in-the-trees-along-the-fence.wav`
(77,160,456 B, i16 stereo 48 kHz → 48,850,493 B flq).

## Result table

| run | -j | out bytes | wall s | cpu s | peak heap | realtime | identical to baseline |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| before (task start) | 24 | 48,850,493 | 4.25 | ~38 | 26.6 MiB | ~95x | reference |
| after | 24 | 48,850,493 | **1.69** | 35.2 | 26.7 MiB | **237.9x** | yes — SHA-256 equal |
| after | 1 | 48,850,493 | 19.63 | 19.1 | 1.9 MiB | 20.5x | yes — hash equal to -j24 |

Byte identity: `v1_vectors_conform` re-encodes all vectors and compares
bytes (54/56 release tests pass); `thread_parity` at 4 threads passes;
large-file `-j1` and `-j24` outputs hash-identical and match the earlier
verified baseline size; five corpus files (incl. `129217__...` at
130,933 B) earlier matched `single.csv` byte counts exactly.

Per-stage cpu profile (FLQ_PROF=1, -j24, 35 s cpu total), before → after:

| stage | before ms | after ms |
|---|---|---|
| rANS pass 1 (model walk) | 22,100* | 11,163 |
| rANS pass 2 (reverse encode) | — | 7,735 |
| proxy (order ranking dots) | 6,700 | 5,373 |
| residual scan (zigzag/prefix) | 3,660 | 1,798 |
| partition eval | 3,270 | 2,906 |
| predict_map | 2,260 | ~1,600 |

*(before-split rANS total was ~22 s over both passes)

Changes:

- `v1/enc.rs`: frame pipeline — bounded job channel + result reordering;
  workers pull jobs, writer emits in seq order (was synchronized batches
  of `threads` jobs; straggler stall removed: parallel efficiency
  15x → ~21x of 24 cores). Errors route through a fatal slot so workers
  always drain and join cleanly; lost jobs fail instead of hanging.
- `codec.rs`: AVX2 `dot_i32` for i32-fitting windows (plain, not
  wrapping, i32×i32→i64 lanes — lane order provably irrelevant);
  `predict_map_avx2` + dispatch hoisted out of per-position loops;
  `w32`/`qr` computed once per signal (was per candidate); coefficients
  padded to multiples of 8 (zero lanes contribute 0) so small orders
  need no scalar tail; `eval_order`/`ltp`/`lms` thread an incumbent
  `cap` into `plan_residual_cap`.
- `rc.rs`: `ProbBin::adapt` → 8 KiB `ADAPT0/1` const LUT + fused
  `step0`/`step1`; `put_prob`'s `u64` division → `mulhi` against a
  compile-time `MAGIC` table (exact for `x < 2^52`, error term proven
  in comment); `RcEnc` generalized over a `Cells` sink — `Vec<u16>`
  records blobs, `u64` counts probe cells without storing them;
  `RcEnc::with_capacity(512)` skips the blob doubling chain.
- `bits.rs`: `plan_residual` → `plan_residual_cap(e, cap)`; Rice level
  eval breaks at internal `best.cost` (a level that can't beat the rice
  incumbent can never win); rANS tail-stop: per-partition `old`/`floor`
  bounds + suffix potential — partitions after the stop are skipped only
  when `B_running − remaining_potential ≥ cap` makes losing rigorous;
  probe path uses stride-2 reads into `e` (no `collect` copies);
  `cs`/`fine_max` flattened to one allocation; transposed `cs` layout +
  pairwise-merge `lvl_max` level table (one lookup per partition);
  chunk-prefix scan → `scan_chunks_avx2` (u64×4 zigzag/shift/add lanes,
  guarded by `max_u < 2^51` so lane sums ≡ saturating adds, scalar
  fallback kept); rANS pass-1 writes `pb` via raw pointer with a
  per-sample capacity guard.
- `main.rs`: `codec::prof::dump()` (env-gated, no-op without FLQ_PROF).

Reverted experiment (documented, not in tree): AVX2 pass-1 sample kernel
(packed-prob vectors + blend updates) cost +48% on `rans_p1` — per-sample
constant setup + `extend_from_slice` overhead dominates when most
quotients are 1–3. Scalar path kept.

Also: earlier residual-cap experiments that caused byte drift were fixed
by (a) never letting a cap-truncated partition level update internal
`best` (its param count wouldn't match `p` on the wire) and (b) using
external `cap` only through the rigorous tail-stop, never as the level
selection bound (a full Rice level over cap can still win after the rANS
improvement).

Verification: `cargo build --release`, `cargo test --release`
(54 + 2 pass, 2 ignored generators), `cargo clippy --release
--all-targets` (0 warnings), `-j1`/`-j24` hash equality, size equality
against `single.csv`-era baseline.

## Post-verification bug + fix (same day)

A 148-file re-sweep (`gate148.py`) caught an **intermittent silent
crash** (exit 0xC0000374 = heap corruption, no stderr) on
`869244__...rumble-design-20269.wav` — a float file whose large
significand residuals produce unary quotients > 64. Root cause: pass-1's
raw-pointer writes — the per-sample `len + head + 1` capacity guard ran
before the `q > 64` tail's `Vec::push` calls, which could fill capacity
exactly, so the stop-bit `*ptr.add(len)` landed one element past the
allocation. Fixed by re-checking `len + 1 > capacity` after the tail.
Post-fix: 15/15 looped encodes clean, identical output bytes; this is
also why a cap-recheck comment now sits on the stop-bit write.
